data.title: U.S. CISA adds an MLflow flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog
data.description: U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) adds an MLflow vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. data.kql_query:
// SENTINEL APEX — CVE-2026-64849 — Anomalous Activity Detection
// Product: Web Application | Generated: 2026-08-22T01:14:04Z
let lookback = 1d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where EventID in (4625, 4648, 4728, 4740, 4776)
| summarize FailureCount = count(), DistinctTargets = dcount(TargetUserName)
    by IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where FailureCount > 10 or DistinctTargets > 5
| extend Severity = "MEDIUM", CVE = "CVE-2026-64849", RuleSource = "SENTINEL-APEX"
| order by TimeGenerated desc
